1510399.steps:
1. Navigate to Network/Routing page, click tab "Route Policies", switch to IPv4 view page;
  2. Click Add button to add a new route policy, then an add route policy dialog box opens;
  3. Check all fields on this dialog box, src any, destination Network 20.1.1.0/24, select radio button "Multi-Path Route";
  4. Select "Gateway Number:" as 4, configure interface and gateway as X2 and X2 gateway, configure interface2 and gateway2 as X3 and X3 gateway, configure interface3 and gateway3 as X4 and X4 gateway, configure interface4 and gateway4 as X5 and X5 gateway, metric,name as "ecmp' click ok button.
  5.use CLI command:show route-policy ipv4 name ecmp get the policy UUID
  6.use CLI commands to edit the policy
  configure
  route-policy ipv4 uuid XXXXXXX
  nexthop-number 3
  interface2 X2
  gateway2 name "X2 Default Gateway"
  interface3 X4
  gateway3 name "X4 Default Gateway"
  end
  commit
  7.Run continuous and large traffic to the destination, check connection monitor or packet monitor;
